sentences.text: 2. The claimants-respondent no.1

approached the 3rd Additional District Judge-cum-4th Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Cuttack under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 seeking compensation on account of injury sustained by her in a road accident owing to rash and negligent driving of offending vehicle-bus bearing registration No.OR-14W- 3973 while she was returning in a Bolero vehicle bearing registration No.OR-05AP-3573 along with others from Puri to her village, by way of an application which was registered as MAC Case No.277 of 2014/154 of 2017 (Computer No.6860 of 2014).

sentences.text:
With the consent of Smt. Amulya Mohanty, learned counsel for the appellants and on concession of Smt. Tapaswini Sinha, Advocate for the respondents, it is agreed that the awarded compensation amount of Rs.75,000/- (Rupees Seventy-five thousand only) be enhanced to Rs.1,50,000/-
(consolidated) (Rupees One Lakh Fifty Thousands only).

The said consolidated amount of Rs.1,50,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Fifty Thousands only) shall be deposited before the learned Tribunal within eight weeks hence, failing which the respondent no.1 shall be at liberty to realize the said amount with interest @6% per annum from the appellant.
On such deposit being made, the said amount shall be disbursed to the respondent no.1 within a month of such deposit.

6. The statutory amount deposited in the Registry of this Court along with the accrued interest thereon shall be refunded to the appellant-Odisha Road Transport Corporation on filing of receipt showing such deposit.
Accordingly, MACA is disposed of.
8. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
(M.S. Raman, J.) nd 2 National Lok Adalat Laxmikant/Aswini Signed by: LAXMIKANT MOHAPATRA

3. Vide Judgment dated 09.12.2019, said matter got disposed of with an award of compensation to the tune of // 2 // Rs.75,000/- (rupees Seventy-five thousand only) with simple interest @ 6% per annum from 09.04.2014 till actual payment.
It was directed for payment of the said amount to the respondent no.1 within a period of two months hence, failing which the petitioner shall be at liberty to realize the said amount with interest @12% per annum from the appellants.
4. Challenging said award, the appellant-O.S.R.T.C. approached this Court in appeal which was registered as MACA No.634 of 2020.
With the consent of Smt. Amulya Mohanty, learned counsel for the appellants and on concession of Smt. Tapaswini Sinha, Advocate for the respondents, it is agreed that the awarded compensation amount of Rs.75,000/- (Rupees Seventy-five thousand only) be enhanced to Rs.1,50,000/-
(consolidated) (Rupees One Lakh Fifty Thousands only).
The said consolidated amount of Rs.1,50,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Fifty Thousands only) shall be deposited before the learned Tribunal within eight weeks hence, failing which the respondent no.1 shall be at liberty to realize the said amount with interest @6% per annum from the appellant.
On such deposit being made, the said amount shall be disbursed to the respondent no.1 within a month of such deposit.
6. The statutory amount deposited in the Registry of this Court along with the accrued interest thereon shall be refunded to the appellant-Odisha Road Transport Corporation on filing of receipt showing such deposit.
Accordingly, MACA is disposed of.
